name: Mississippi Metal Manufacturing
old_description: Located in Pontotoc Mississippi, we have been in business since 2004.  We provide direct service
about:
Mississippi Metal Manufacturing operates from Pontotoc, Mississippi, where it has been in business since 2004. The company is a subsidiary of Moore's Feed, a local agricultural and retail operation, and was established to supply metal building components to the surrounding region.

The firm manufactures "PBR" and "PLP" roof and wall panels in acrylic-coated Galvalume and a range of painted colors, and rolls cold-formed purlins — including Zee, Cee, open-face channel, eave strut, and angle profiles — on site. It also maintains a warehouse stock of structural steel such as I-beams, channel, flat bar, tubing, pipe, and angle iron, along with metal building accessories like roll-up doors, personnel doors, exhaust fans, louvers, and fiberglass and bubble-wrap insulation. Standard panel and trim orders placed before 10 a.m. are available for same-day pickup, while custom purlin orders typically ship within one to three business days.

Its primary customers are home improvement centers, building supply stores, and other retail outlets across Mississippi, Alabama, and Tennessee. The company also serves local retail buyers through Moore's Feed in Pontotoc, providing access to items not commonly carried as off-the-shelf inventory at most retailers.

Mississippi Metal Manufacturing emphasizes timely service and local convenience, offering direct delivery to retail partners and custom trim fabrication to match specific project requirements. The operation is Energy Star certified, reflecting a stated commitment to energy-efficient building products.
